_comment: Corrections to the published Studio LFT programming. HQ occasionally publishes the wrong session for a date and the studio finds out afterwards. These are re-applied automatically on every merge (see apply_corrections in src/parse_lft_pdf.py), so re-parsing a month's PDF can't silently undo them. Each entry replaces the listed dates' workout (sections + session notes) with another date's, leaving the date's own week / cycle label / focus alone.

corrections.note: The published Pump B2 W3 Day 2 Upper session was wrong; these days run the same workout as Aug 26/27.
